in_marathi.name: Bantu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's little warrior
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bantu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bantu’ meaning ‘little one’, this name is associated with the gods and is a symbol of strength and courage. In Hindu mythology, Bantu is a name given to the little warrior gods who protect and guide their devotees.
